sidebar.noTasks: No tasks yet. Start one and its desktop appears here.
sidebar.dragHint: Drag a task onto the screens to open it beside the others.

empty.title: Nothing open
empty.body: Choose a task on the left, or start a new one. Drag a second task here to watch them side by side, up to four.

drop.add: Drop to open this task beside the others
drop.replace: Drop on a screen to put this task there
drop.full: Four screens are open. Drop on one to replace it.

task.deleteBody: Its desktop, everything on it and the conversation are deleted. This cannot be undone.
task.missing: This task is not here any more. It may have been deleted.

desktop.label: The desktop of {title}

starting.title: Starting the desktop
starting.body: A new computer is being made for this task. It usually takes about two minutes. What you asked for is already waiting for the agent.

stopping.title: Stopping the desktop
stopping.body: The machine is being released. Its files are kept.

stopped.title: The desktop is stopped
stopped.body: Its files are kept. Start it to continue where the task left off.

desktop.lost: The connection to the desktop was lost. Reconnecting.

chat.label: Conversation with the agent
chat.empty: Tell the agent what to do. It works on the desktop beside this, where you can watch.
chat.waitingForDesktop: The agent will read this when the desktop is ready.
chat.desktopStopped: The desktop is stopped. Start it and the agent reads this.

newTask.title: New task
newTask.promptPlaceholder: Open our staging site, sign up as a new customer and tell me where the flow breaks.
newTask.environmentHint: What the desktop comes with. Change these under Environments.

createTeam.title: Create a team
createTeam.body: A team shares its tasks and environments. You can invite people after you create it.

noTeam.title: You're not on a team
noTeam.body: Create one to start a task, or open an invitation someone sent you.
